_source: HEDB Data Dictionary 202601, sheet 'Inst Research Units' (Institute - Research & Innovation Unit)
_note: New 2026-10-22. raw_column values are the dictionary's 'Database Field Name' column verbatim, except the two duplicated contact columns (see their notes). Zoho stores the DISPLAY text for every dropdown; the production push workflow converts each one back to its CHEDS code.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list -- the Zoho lookup displays [Name] and is filtered to Code == "141".
Reference only -- the Zoho form derives the name from the Institutional Codes lookup, so no column is written.
No conversion. Zoho field is 'Year' (Year_field), max 4 chars; the push sends rec.Year_field.toString().
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.

Raw R&I Unit Type code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text using an 8-entry table (e.g. 'RSU' -> 'Research Administration & Funding Support Unit'; 'RCU' -> 'Research Center Unit'). The push workflow converts it back to the code via Dropdown_Fields.research_inovation_type().
No conversion. CHEDS requires a 4-digit year not later than the current year.

Multi-select. Each comma-separated Fields-of-R&D code is converted to the exact Zoho multi-select text and re-joined with ', ' (e.g. '2.1, 3.5, 5.3' -> 'Civil Engineering, Other Medical Sciences, Educational Sciences'). WARNING: the HEDB 'Fields of R&D' sheet numbers Nanotechnology 2.11 in its code column but 2.10 in its outline column, and Excel stores both as floats so 2.10 reads back as '2.1' -- which collides with Civil Engineering. Both 2.10 and 2.11 are accepted here as Nanotechnology; confirm the intended code with CHEDS before the first push.

value_map.E3: E3 - Carbon Dioxide Capture and Storage
value_map.H1: H1 - Cardiovascular Disorders and Metabolic Syndrome
value_map.D2: D2 - Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence

fields._note: Raw R&D Priority code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text ('E0' -> 'E0 - Energy Transition'); the push sends .subString(0,2) to recover the code. WARNING: CHEDS says multiple priorities are permissible, but the Zoho field is a single-select picklist, so only one code per row can be carried today.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
No conversion. Value is AED, whole number (no currency symbol or thousands separators).

Multi-select. Each comma-separated Funding Source Type code is converted to the exact Zoho multi-select text and re-joined with ', ' (e.g. 'G, HEI' -> 'Government, Higher Education Institutions'). The push workflow converts it back via Dropdown_Fields.Funding_source_type().
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.

value_map.UN: Use in case of GCC students who do not have addresses within UAE

fields._note: Raw Emirates code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text ('AD' -> 'Abu Dhabi'); the push converts it back via Dropdown_Fields.Emirates_code().
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.

Unit HEAD's email. NOTE: HEDB 202601 gives the same Database Field Name 'Contact_Email' to both the unit head's email and the unit's email. This entry takes the first occurrence; the unit-level one is read from 'Contact_Email_Unit' -- rename that second column in the raw file before building.

Unit HEAD's phone (Zoho field is plain text, so the raw formatting is kept). NOTE: HEDB 202601 reuses 'Contact_Phone' for both the head's and the unit's phone -- the unit-level one is read from 'Contact_Phone_Unit'.

Unit-level email. TODO: HEDB 202601 names this column 'Contact_Email', identical to the unit head's. Two identical headers cannot coexist in one sheet, so rename the second one to 'Contact_Email_Unit' in the raw file (or change this raw_column to whatever CHEDS actually emits).

Unit-level phone, cleaned to digits plus a leading '+' because the Zoho field is a Phone Number type. TODO: HEDB 202601 names this column 'Contact_Phone', identical to the unit head's -- rename the second one to 'Contact_Phone_Unit' in the raw file.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
Reference only -- CHEDS says to send Last Updated ONLY through the master API. The Zoho form stamps lastUpdated itself on a successful push.
